itens.notas: China JuUI 9 on Android 9 (PPR2.180905.006.A1 / 02.02.60.01): ad SDK/service, telemetry, vendor push channel, store/hotel/demo and tutorial apps, preloaded content, the vendor screensaver, AI photo recognition, family album/cloud/message board, single listen and the voice chat room; debloat only, stock Home `com.jamdeo.tv.vod` and Live TV `com.jamdeo.tv.livetv` kept, OTA kept; 29 packages; `ro.adb.secure=1`, so the TV asks for the ADB key once, and states can be lost if you reboot right after disabling - wait a minute; [device notes](hisense-65e5h/README.md)
cabecalho: Hisense 65E5H (reports ro.product.model "VIDAA_TV", device MTK9652, board hisense_m7642_cn), China
JuUI 9 on Android 9 (API 28), build PPR2.180905.006.A1 `release-keys`, incremental 02.02.60.01.
Panel reported as 1920x1080 / density 320, ABIs armeabi-v7a only, 126 packages installed and
nothing disabled at the factory. Stock Home is com.jamdeo.tv.vod (com.ju.main.launcher.LauncherActivity)
and Live TV is com.jamdeo.tv.livetv; both are left enabled, so this is a debloat-only list.
ro.adb.secure=1 on this firmware: the TV asks "Allow USB debugging?" for the computer once and keeps
the key. service.adb.tcp.port=5555, so USB debugging alone opens the port over Wi-Fi, no cable and
no separate network-debugging toggle. Reaching USB debugging needs the factory menu on this set
(ToFac U->M, then the Menu key on the version page opens native Settings); README.md in this folder
has the steps, including the prompt problems and the ToFac switch back to U. Switch USB debugging
off when done: on this firmware it also leaves ADB open on port 5555 over Wi-Fi.

itens.titulo: PPTV p34a4p (Suning PPTV, Amlogic board), China
itens.notas: First PPTV list; SDK 22, so the repo launcher (minSdk 26) cannot run: debloat only; `pm disable-user` denied (SecurityException, the FFalcon r34a0 / Whaley wall), the list is applied with `pm hide` / `pm unhide` and survives reboots; five ad/push/silent-install packages, the Amlogic bootanimation video ad (five `persist.sys.*` properties, in the header) and the network-layer ads (launcher hifuntv/huan feed, hpplay cast promos) — those layers, the domains that must stay reachable and the stock launcher's HOME lock-in (a custom `HOME.pptv` category; hiding the launcher kills the HOME key after a reboot) are in [the device note](../docs/devices/pptv-p34a4p.md); MyInstallReceiver watchdog reinstall chain dies once its INSTALL_PACKAGES holders are hidden; eight further hides crashed the launcher in a boot loop and were reverted; ADB 5555 open with no auth; reboot-checked
cabecalho: PPTV p34a4p (Suning PPTV, Amlogic board), Android 5.1.1, build LMY47V.20251117, 1 GB RAM.
Tested 2026-10-24. First PPTV list.
ADB: 5555, no auth (ro.adb.secure=0); the owner re-opens network debugging after a power cycle.
Stock launcher: com.pptv.launcher (locked in, see below). Live TV: com.pptv.tv.
Apply:   NOT tools/disable.sh — it uses pm disable-user, which this firmware DENIES (see
the blocker below). Hide each package instead, one pm command per shell call:
grep -vE '^\s*(#|$)' examples/pptv-p34a4p/debloat.txt | sed -E 's/\s+#.*$//' \
| awk '{print "pm hide " $1}' | TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/venv/bin/python -I tools/tv.py --batch
Undo:    NOT tools/restore.sh — its pm enable cannot undo a hide on this firmware.
Same as Apply, but `pm unhide`.
